purpose: Two bounded engineering checks of the new offline analysis helper ledger control; not a training, planning, performance or scientific-result experiment

fixture.kind: Five explicit synthetic JSONL events with canonical SHA256 chain
fixture.debit_semantics: Literal fictional history only. No actual request, optimizer attempt or optimizer update is executed or claimed by these numbers.

checks: Canonical sequence/tail extend by exactly one start and one close
Original binding/caps/debit counters and carry wall remain unchanged
Analysis request/debit APIs reject without invoking callbacks
Synthetic session closes and releases its own writer lock
The real locked constructor rejects a second analysis on the same synthetic journal
Rejected repeat does not change journal bytes or leave a writer lock

numerical_tolerance: Exact bytes/identity/counters/sequence and exact representable literal wall value 0.125; no planner or learning numeric tolerance is used
failure_policy: Retain fixture, partial files and failure report. Do not delete or retry, alter a formal ledger, reset any failure/budget, or infer planning-quality improvement.
evidence_limit: A PASS can establish these two engineering control checks only. It does not verify formal requests/results, planning performance, DRL benefit, physical safety, IK or joint trajectories.
